estimator.name: tail_Polyak_Ruppert_average
estimator.risk: T-048 exact vector scheduled PR risk with T-049 exact task lag covariances

probe_ceiling.interpretation: optimistic full-cost oracle ceiling only; no learned probe estimator is evaluated

analysis.strong_fixed_selection: minimum geometric full-budget exact risk over the complete registered rho grid
analysis.cellwise_fixed_oracle: minimum full-budget risk among fixed q schedules
analysis.dynamic_oracle: minimum risk over the complete fixed and two-stage library

mandatory_gates.V1: all public task kernels, policies, stationary laws, drifts, and lag covariances pass exact validity checks
mandatory_gates.V2: all registered full-budget and post-probe rows are finite, stable, dual-budget feasible, and have nonempty averaging windows
mandatory_gates.V3: the full-cost schedule oracle improves the strongest deployable fixed-q baseline by at least 5 percent in aggregate
mandatory_gates.V4: the full-cost schedule oracle strictly improves the strongest deployable fixed-q baseline in at least 50 percent of cells
mandatory_gates.V5: the best nonconstant post-probe schedule improves the cellwise full-budget fixed-q oracle by at least 1 percent in aggregate
mandatory_gates.V6: a nonconstant post-probe schedule strictly improves the cellwise full-budget fixed-q oracle in at least 25 percent of cells
mandatory_gates.V7: oracle mean participation is nonincreasing along at least 80 percent of adjacent rho comparisons
mandatory_gates.V8: the selected oracle support contains at least two fixed schedules and at least one nonconstant schedule
mandatory_gates.V9: no earlier result row, sampled trajectory, pilot seed, formal seed, confidence interval, GPU job, or HPC4 job is used
mandatory_gates.V10: a clean rerun is byte-identical and configuration, runner, core, task, rows, and summary SHA-256 values are recorded

stop_rule: Any failed mandatory gate forbids a learned EXP-021A pilot. Thresholds, tasks, schedules, costs, and populations may not be changed after execution.
